subject: Weekly numbers: final submit + roundtable agenda
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: olivia.park@nimbushealth.com
Date: Mon, 13 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly numbers: final submit + roundtable agenda

Team —

Quick heads-up: forecasting window closes Wednesday, 17:00 PT. Please do two things by EOD Tuesday so we can run the finance checks on Wednesday morning: 

1) Update your top-20 deals in the Q2_commit_tracker.csv (attached). Use the Stage / Commit column exactly as the template shows.
2) Hit Submit in HubSpot (Deals > Edit > Forecast > Submit) so RevOps pulls the correct snapshot.

Agenda for our Wed 10:30 sync (30m):
- 10:30 (5m) Quick roll call + blockers
- 10:35 (10m) Deals at risk (>50% ARR, stage regression risk) — owners call out mitigations
- 10:45 (10m) Commit changes and rationale (pricing / procurement dependencies)
- 10:55 (5m) Action items & post-sync owners

If you have follow-ups for Olivia (Nimbus finance), flag them in the tracker and cc her. I’ve attached the latest template and a one-page checklist.

Attachments: forecast_template_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet), Q2_commit_tracker.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks Hannah — uploaded my top-20 and marked two items as 'commit tentative' with notes on procurement timing. 

Quick clarifiers:
- Deal NIM-4312 (Nimbus) is waiting on their legal and a one-week extension to purchase order submission. I’ve put the expected close date as 03/29 and left Stage at "Procurement" per the template.
- I also added a short summary for any pricing concessions (see tracker column "Discount Rationale").

I'll be on the Wed sync. If anyone wants a 1:1 before then to run through the bigger opportunities, ping me and I’ll carve time.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
